name: distributed-ic3-r2
cmd: GDP_POOL=ic3 GDP_POOL_MS=4000 GDP_POOL_GROW=1 GDP_POOL_PICKS=research/protocols/engine/picks/distributed_lock.txt GDP_INFER_TRACE=2 timeout -s KILL 100 bun research/protocols/run.ts --ms 60000 --only distributed_lock --skip given,broken 2>/tmp/e.log; s=$?; grep -E 'POOL|join (small instance|failed|enumerated|houdini)' /tmp/e.log | cut -c1-3000; exit $s
